title: fix(spec): the page liveness ledger grades the app page record binding live, citing its console readers
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuKB8Sg6c6sVpL96ruVvdxaf)_

Fixes #30094

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`packages/spec/liveness/page.json` 里 app 页面 `record` 绑定及其全部子键(object/view/filter 及 field/operator/value、sort 及 field/order)从 `planned` 改判 `live`,每行引用控制台里真正读取它的代码;同步重生成 `state-counts/page.md`(live 35→42,planned 9→2),并加一条 `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset。
- 为什么改:旧行写着「还没有渲染器读页面级 `record`」,但 `ui/` 里的 PageView 已经按这个绑定读出首行并作为 `record` 交给每个组件的 `visibleWhen`;过期的 `planned` 会让作者和 AI 以为这个键不起作用。
- 风险与回滚:只改台账数据与生成计数,不动 schema、不动 `ui/`、无运行时行为变化;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/liveness/page.json` 的 `record` 块(容器行的 evidence 与 note);`packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/page.md`;`.changeset/30094-page-record-liveness-regrade.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness`,预期末行 `✓ … every path#symbol anchor names a symbol its file contains …` 且 `state-counts/ is current`,退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Each `props.record.*` row of the `page` ledger is regraded from the renderer in this checkout, following the README regrade recipe: a `path#symbol` citation at the reader, `verifiedAt: 2026-11-05`, `evidenceScope: in-repo`, and a `producer` where the read depends on a second input (the page's adapter). No row stays `planned`: every key has a reader.

| Row | Old | New | Reader citation |
|---|---|---|---|
| `record` | planned | live | `PageView.tsx#appPageRecordBinding` (an `app` page only, a binding that names its object) → the AppPageRecord element `PageView.tsx#PageView` mounts around the page body → `PageView.tsx#AppPageRecordRead` (first row, `$top: 1`) → `ExpressionProvider.tsx#PageRecordScope` (publishes it as `record`) → `SchemaRenderer.tsx#buildNodeEvaluationScope` (spread into every component's `visibleWhen`) |
| `record.object` | planned | live | `PageView.tsx#AppPageRecordGate` lands it on `objectName` (`element-data-source.ts#composeElementDataSource`); `PageView.tsx#AppPageRecordRead` calls `dataSource.find(object, params)` |
| `record.view` | planned | live | `useElementDataSource.ts#useElementDataSource` reads `config.view`, lists the saved views and resolves the name (an unresolved name draws the gate's error panel, never a wider read); `element-data-source.ts#composeElementDataSource` AND-combines the view filter and takes the view sort when the binding has none |
| `record.filter` | planned | live | `ElementDataSourceGate.tsx#useElementDataSourceSchema` (the page mapping's `filter: true` lowers it with `toFilterNodeSafely`); `PageView.tsx#AppPageRecordRead` resolves placeholder tokens and sends it as `$filter` |
| `record.filter.field` | planned | live | `filter-converter.ts#viewFilterRuleToNode` (left operand of the lowered comparison) |
| `record.filter.operator` | planned | live | `filter-converter.ts#viewFilterRuleToNode` (normalised by `normalizeFilterOperator`) |
| `record.filter.value` | planned | live | `filter-converter.ts#viewFilterRuleToNode` (right operand) |
| `record.sort` | planned | live | `PageView.tsx#AppPageRecordRead` sends it as `params.$orderby` beside `$top: 1`; `element-data-source.ts#composeElementDataSource` (binding sort overrides the view's) |
| `record.sort.field` | planned | live | `data-objectstack/src/index.ts#serializeOrderBy` (`field` / `-field` on the wire `sort`) |
| `record.sort.order` | planned | live | `data-objectstack/src/index.ts#serializeOrderBy` (`desc`, case-insensitive, selects `-field`) |

All `ui/` paths are rooted at `ui/packages/`: `app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx`, `app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx`, `react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx`, `react/src/hooks/useElementDataSource.ts`, `react/src/element-data-source/ElementDataSourceGate.tsx`, `core/src/data-scope/element-data-source.ts`, `core/src/utils/filter-converter.ts`, `data-objectstack/src/index.ts`.

**The predicate scope the old note said was missing.** The old note measured objectui `main` @79cb8c03eb, where `record` came only from `RecordContext`, which a record block provides to its own body. The page host now mounts `PageRecordScope`, which adds the page row as `record` to the ambient predicate scope; `buildNodeEvaluationScope` spreads that scope first, so every component predicate on the page reads it, and a record block that binds its own row still overrides `record` for its own subtree.

**Changeset.** `packages/spec/package.json` `files[]` lists `liveness`, so `liveness/page.json` ships in the npm tarball: `@objectstack/spec` `patch`, with both declaration lines.

## Why

A stale `planned` row tells authors and agents that the key does nothing. The ledger is what the gate, the enforce-or-remove channel and the AI authoring surfaces read as the capability catalogue, and this row was written before the console's reader landed.

## Tests

No code changed, so no test was added. The reader is already pinned by `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/PageView.appPageRecord-12931.test.tsx` (tier and count predicates, one read per page open with the org token resolved in `$filter`, no binding and a non-app page read nothing, 0 rows, 403 read as no row, failure fails closed). That test covers `object` and the `filter` rule keys. `view` and `sort` are cited at their readers only.

## Acceptance notes

- **The schema's prose is stale too, left alone here.** `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` still says "Planned in the renderer: until the console mounts it, `record` stays unbound on an app page" in the `record` key's `.describe()` and in the `PageRecordBindingSchema` TSDoc. The same file's `visibleWhen` describe already states the binding is read. The ruling for this card is no schema change, so this is a follow-up for the spec owner (a `.describe()` edit regenerates `check:docs` artifacts). The ledger row wins over a describe marker, so the gate's verdict is unaffected.
- The README `page` Notes cell ("live, plus the one dead tombstone below") is now exactly true for the `record` subtree and was not edited. The 2 rows still `planned` in `page` are outside `record`.
- Gate sweep: the `--commands` families derived on the committed head, exit codes captured to disk, `--ran` reconciled. Readings are in Verification.

## Verification

All readings on head `7a3032f3b`, the final commit; exit codes captured before any pipe.

<details><summary>check:liveness — exit 0</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness` before regenerating the counts: exit 1, the only failure being the stale `page` shard (`35 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 9` became `42 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 2`). `gen:liveness-counts` rewrote 1 shard (`page.md`). Re-run: exit 0, with every `path#symbol` anchor resolving, every cited file naming its key, and `state-counts/ is current`.
</details>

<details><summary>Liveness vitest — 12/12 files, 359/359 tests</summary>

`bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c 'pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:migration-registry && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/liveness'` printed `Test Files 12 passed (12)`, `Tests 359 passed (359)` and `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families — 57 derived, 57 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (derived zero)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 57 commands from the change set (3 paths, 105 changed lines). Every one exited 0, and `--ran` with `command :: exit N` records printed `57 derived, 57 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (a DERIVED zero: all 57 carry an exit code, none of them 3).
Three needed a second run. `check:generated`: in the first sweep the `check:test-typecheck` lane's tsc died with no diagnostics, because the sweep ran without `NODE_OPTIONS`. Run alone with `--max-old-space-size=4096`, that gate held (52 files / 240 errors / 131 pinned signatures, unchanged), and `check:generated` re-ran with all 14 artifacts up to date. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET). After `turbo run build` (120/120 tasks) both exited 0.
Local-only families: `check:dev-prereqs` exit 0, `check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No schema touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (None added.)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No lintable source changed; CI runs it.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed (`state-counts/page.md`; `check:generated` 14/14).
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (except the 维护者速读 section, which is written in Chinese by design).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
